{text} is where your text goes; without it, the text follows the prompt. In the panel, type the keyword and then the text, or nothing to use what you copied. The answer comes from the model on this device where the system has one; otherwise the Gemini app opens with the prompt and the text.
Rewrite this text in a friendlier tone. Reply with only the new text.

string-array.name: prompt_seeds
string-array.item: fix|Fix spelling|Fix the spelling and grammar of this text. Keep its language and its wording. Reply with only the corrected text.\n\n{text}
shorter|Shorter|Rewrite this text to be shorter and clearer, in the same language. Reply with only the rewritten text.\n\n{text}
de|In German|Translate this text into German. Reply with only the translation.\n\n{text}
sum|Summary|Summarise this text in one or two sentences, in the language it is written in. Reply with only the summary.\n\n{text}
explain|Explain|Explain this in two short, plain sentences.\n\n{text}

string-array.name: guide
string-array.item: apps|open|open||chrome|Apps|Type a name; the icons on its row are what else it can do
places|open|left||chrome left|An app, in a place|left, right third, top left, full… for an app that is not open yet
commands|open|bolt||{command}|What other apps offer|Their own shortcuts and commands, as rows
settings|open|settings|settings|s wifi|Settings|s, then Tab: every settings page
keys|open|key|keys|k snap|Keyboard shortcuts|k, then Tab: what the system’s keys do
links|open|search||{link}|Your links|A keyword, then what to search for
web|open|globe||weather berlin|The web|The last row searches for what you typed
note|write|note|note|note buy milk|Note|A dated line in Notes.md
notes|write|note|notes|notes milk|Find a note|Lines of Notes.md, newest first
todo|write|check|todo|todo call the bank|To-do|A task for Todo.md; todo alone shows what is open
mail|write|mail|mail|mail anna@example.com Lunch? / See you at 1|Mail|The compose window, filled in
event|write|event|event|event Fri 3pm Dentist|Event|The calendar’s editor, filled in
remind|write|bell|remind|remind 5pm call the bank|Reminder|A timer, an alarm or an event, depending on when
new|write|plus|new|new doc Q3 plan|New|A file, a folder, a doc, a sheet or slides
timer|time|timer|timer|timer 10m tea|Timer|The Clock starts it; Start and pin keeps the countdown on top
alarm|time|bell|alarm|alarm 7:30 gym|Alarm|The Clock sets it
sums|answers|calc||12*3.5|Sums|Enter copies the answer
color|answers|edit||#3478f6|Colours|The same colour in HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH, each to copy
password|answers|key||password 20|Passwords|A new one each time
qr|answers|qr|qr|qr https://example.com|QR code|To scan from the screen, copy, save or share
emoji|answers|smile|emoji|emoji party|Emoji|A grid to pick from; Enter copies
sym|answers|text|sym|sym arrow|Symbols|Arrows, maths, currency
abc|answers|letters|abc|abc german|Letters|ä ö ü ß, æ ø å and other languages\' letters: by language, by letter (abc a), by mark (abc umlaut)
prompts|text|spark||{prompt}|Prompts|Your text, answered by the model on this device
ask|text|spark|ask|ask how do I fold a fitted sheet|Ask Gemini|Hands the text to the Gemini app
clip|text|clip|clip|clip |Clipboard|What you copied: upper case, a note, a QR code…
snip|text|text|snip|snip add sig / Best, Alex|Snippets|Pieces of text under short names
pin|text|pin|pin|pin gate B22, 14:05|Pin|A line in a small window that stays on top
vol|controls|volume|vol|vol 30|Volume|Or the arrow keys on its row
brightness|controls|sun|brightness|brightness 60|Brightness|Or the arrow keys on its row
play|controls|music|play|play lofi|Play|Asks the music app
window|booklight|booklight||booklight|Booklight’s window|Settings, and your links, snippets, recipes and prompts

resources.string: Tips are off. Turn them on again in Booklight’s window.
When you open Booklight and type nothing, it shows one thing it can do. Each tip is shown once.

string-array.name: tips
string-array.item: help|list|?|Everything|lists all that Booklight does, each with an example to try
places|left|chrome left|An app, in a place|opens Chrome in the left half if it is not open yet. Also: top left, full
settings|settings|s wifi|Settings|goes to a settings page. s, Tab, then its name
keys|key|k snap|Keyboard shortcuts|shows the keys for it. k, Tab, then what you want to do
todo|check|todo call the bank|To-do|adds a task to Todo.md. todo alone shows what is open
prompts|spark|{prompt}|Prompts|is corrected on this device, or handed to Gemini where it cannot be
pin|pin|pin gate B22, 14:05|Pin|keeps a line in a small window on top of the others
timer|timer|timer 10m tea|Timer|starts a timer in the Clock. Start and pin keeps the countdown in view
note|note|note buy milk|Note|adds a dated line to Notes.md
clip|clip|clip |Clipboard|shows what you copied and what can be done with it
sums|calc|12*3.5|Sums|is answered as you type. Enter copies
emoji|smile|emoji party|Emoji|shows a grid to pick from. Enter copies

resources.string: Everything Booklight does, each with an example. Enter on a row opens Booklight and types it for you; nothing is run until you press Enter there.
What your other apps offer becomes rows: “new event” opens the calendar’s editor. Booklight starts nothing of theirs before you press Enter, and they never see what you type.
None of your apps offers anything yet.

Prompts are answered by the system’s own model on this device, where it has one; your text stays here. The library that reaches it reports how it is used to Google (not what you type): the privacy policy says what.
